headings.usage: Use for H1, H2, H3. Crucial for the 'Alex Hormozi' high-converting masculine feel. Always add 'uppercase' class.

body.usage: Use for all body text, forms, and small UI labels to provide 'Apple-like' precision contrast.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise/grain overlay strictly on black backgrounds to remove digital flatness.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Use generous padding: p-8 to p-12 for cards, py-24 to py-32 for sections. Let elements breathe.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For the 'What You Get' section, use a 3-column bento grid (desktop), 2-col (tablet), 1-col (mobile). The primary features should span 2 columns.
grids_and_layouts.timeline: Vertical staggered layout for the 'Process' section with a connecting 1px glowing line.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text, forms, and grids. Center-align hero and major CTAs to command attention.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal on H1 using framer-motion (initial: y: 100%, opacity: 0 -> animate: y: 0, opacity: 1).
motion.scroll_reveals: Fade up and slightly scale in (0.95 -> 1) for cards and sections as they enter the viewport.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on buttons should subtly scale up (scale-105), increase glow, and lighten text.

sections_and_components.header: Logo only, NO navigation menu. Sticky on scroll with heavy glassmorphism. Never transparent over scrolling content.
sections_and_components.hero: Large kinetic H1, subheadline, embedded VSL (Video Sales Letter). Primary CTA 'Book Your Strategy Call', Secondary CTA 'Watch The Video'. Social proof row below.
sections_and_components.trust_bar: Slow continuous marquee (react-fast-marquee) with pale/outlined text showing services: Professionally Filmed Ads • Google Ads • CRM Automation...
sections_and_components.comparison: Why We're Different. Split layout. Traditional (red/grey, negative) vs Cherry Tree (Royal Blue glow, premium icons, positive).
sections_and_components.process_timeline: Vertical timeline: Apply -> Strategy Call -> We Fly Out -> Film -> Launch -> Scale. Scroll-triggered line fills.
sections_and_components.testimonials: 4 horizontal video testimonial cards with a modal playback (Play icon overlay).
sections_and_components.feature_grid: 12-item bento grid for 'What You Get'. Crisp icons, dark surface cards, 1px border, blue hover glows.
sections_and_components.checklist: Ideal vs Not Ideal. Use Green checkmarks vs Red crosses. High contrast list.
sections_and_components.faq: Shadcn Accordion. Minimal borders, large typography.
sections_and_components.final_cta_form: Massive appointment form. Fields: Owner Name, Company, Email, Phone, Service, Revenue, Postal Code, Website, Notes. 'Request Strategy Call' button with primary gradient and pulse.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gradients meets APCA standards. Use white text (#FFF) for primary, off-white (#A1A1AA) for secondary.
accessibility.focus: All form inputs must have a highly visible focus ring: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2C5CE5].
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You are building a site in Javascript (.js, .jsx), NOT Typescript. Do not output .tsx or .ts files.
Ensure dark mode is fully forced. Use very dark backgrounds (#050505, #0A0A0A) contrasting sharply with Royal Blue (#2C5CE5).
Do NOT apply a universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions to avoid breaking framer-motion.
Do NOT center align the main app container. This disrupts reading flow. Keep text naturally left-aligned unless explicitly centered (e.g., Hero).
Never use generic AI emojis 🤖🧠💭. Use professional icons from 'lucide-react' or 'phosphor-react'.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive elements and inputs MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g. data-testid='submit-form-button').
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications when the form is submitted.
NEVER use placeholder text/URLs for images. ONLY use the provided image URLs in this JSON.
Never use a completely transparent header over scrolling content. Always use backdrop-blur + semi-transparent dark background.
Implement Shadcn UI components for logic but override styles entirely to match the aggressive, bold, dark mode aesthetic.
